status: Provisional single-take evidence; internal image review before animation

patterns.name: Approve identity before buying motion
patterns.workflow: Generate one realistic lifestyle still, inspect face, hands, hair, skin, cotton texture and lighting, save its SHA and internal review, then reference that exact file in every main human-shot request.
patterns.limit: A good still is necessary but does not guarantee good motion.

patterns.name: Silent reading needs its own prompt
patterns.recipe: Keep gaze on the laptop. Lips rest together, hands rest as shown, camera fixed. Allow tiny eye motion, one or two blinks, breath. Remove interview and expressive emotional performance cues.
patterns.limit: Prompt and seed changed; do not attribute improvement to one sentence. Superseded for product interaction: resting hands and downward gaze did not make active computer use clear to the user.

patterns.name: Route the reaction separately
patterns.recipe: Use the same approved still but select the model/take that yields a small closed-mouth smile without broad exhale or mouth opening.
patterns.limit: Kling is slightly softer in the face. This selection is for this shot, not universal model superiority. Historical selection; mouse revision must establish physical interaction before video generation.

patterns.name: Keep the product result beside the person
patterns.recipe: Promote the exact calendar block to a summary card, keep its final pose identical across the modular join, then reveal the person beside it. Both clips share reference, daylight and wardrobe.
patterns.limit: The long UI section separates the two independent shots; not a continuous-camera or continuous-action join.

patterns.name: Approve the intended interaction before animation
patterns.workflow: Generate the hand already gripping a visible mouse, with index/middle on button areas, neutral wrist and forearm, gaze at laptop screen. Inspect full frame and enlarged hand. Regenerate the still if this fails, then animate a small mouse glide and tiny finger click.
patterns.limit: An anatomically plausible resting hand is insufficient evidence of active product usage. Motion requires a separate chronological review.

patterns.name: Separate correct grip from gaze adherence
patterns.recipe: Hold head, chin and eye direction at the approved still angle, watching the center of the upright laptop display continuously. Limit mouse travel to millimeters and one index-finger press.
patterns.observation: Veo v4 preserved a recognizable mouse grip but repeatedly looked down and rotated the mouse. It failed the screen-attention requirement despite improved physical interaction. Kling v5 selected after face/hand review; opening uses settled1.5–6s at0.75x, return0–6s. The selected framing keeps mouse visible.
patterns.limit: V5 model and prompt both change; result does not isolate a causal mechanism.

avoid: Animating an unreviewed or weak source image
Assuming image conditioning guarantees a silent mouth
Using interview prompts for quiet work footage
Overloading subtle motion prompts with repeated emotional micro-actions
Claiming that internal subjective scores are calibrated realism measurements
Asking the video model to invent a mouse grip missing from the still
